controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,095 K and log g 4.34 (u1 0.400, u2 0.294): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
